turningImaginations.title: Turning Little Imaginations into Unforgettable Stories
turningImaginations.description: At Bookerello, we believe every child deserves to become the hero of their own adventure. Our platform helps families create personalised storybooks by choosing themes, adding multiple characters, celebrating special occasions and including meaningful personal details. Each book is thoughtfully created to make reading more exciting, personal and memorable.

createMagicalBook.title: Create Magical Book in 3 Easy Steps
createMagicalBook.subheading: Bring your child's imagination to life by personalising the characters, creating their adventure, and receiving a storybook made just for them.
createMagicalBook.step1Desc: Add your child's name, age and photo. You can also include siblings, family members, friends or pets in the story.
createMagicalBook.step2Desc: Choose the story theme, occasion and illustration style, then add personal details that match your child's interests.
createMagicalBook.step3Desc: Preview the story, select a digital or hardcover format, complete the payment and receive the personalised book.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Discover magical adventures, exciting themes, and heartwarming stories created to make every child the hero.
faq.q1: What is the Kids Book Generator?
faq.a1: It is a simple way to create a magical, personalised storybook where your child is the hero of their very own adventure.
faq.q2: How can I create a personalized kids book?
faq.a2: Choose a story theme, add your child's details, and personalise the adventure in just a few friendly steps.
faq.q3: Can I add my child's name to the story?
faq.a3: Yes. Your child's name is woven naturally into the story to make every page feel made especially for them.
faq.q4: What age groups are the books suitable for?
faq.a4: Our storybooks are designed for curious young readers and make a lovely shared reading experience for families.
faq.q5: Can I choose the story theme or characters?
faq.a5: Yes. Pick the theme that sparks your child's imagination, then create an adventure they will love returning to.
faq.a6: You can personalise key story details so the finished book feels truly unique to your child.
faq.q7: Can I download or print the book?
faq.a7: Your completed storybook can be prepared for you to enjoy and share with your family.
